The proof proceeds along a similar line of argument in [Li21], utilizing higher Green functions and theorems of Gross-Zagier and GrossKohnen-Zagier. The main innovation is to control the valuation of Nm(ϕm(j(E1), j(E2))) at p by relating it to Fourier coeﬃcients of cusp forms with increasing level. This is possible as such valuations are Fourier coeﬃcients of incoherent Eisenstein series with full level, and can be approximated by Fourier coeﬃcients of coherent Eisenstein series with higher levels, which are holomorphic Hilbert modular forms.
